$comment: Exactly what PWABuilder asks for when packaging EgyKode for Windows.
Kept here so the values are typed once and read from a file, rather than
re-entered by hand at each rebuild. A mistyped identity produces a package
the Store rejects at upload, and the error does not say which field was
These are NOT secrets. Package identity, publisher ID, package family name
and package SID are all public: they ship inside the installed package, and
the PFN appears in the Store URL. Nothing here needs protecting — the
signing key belongs to Partner Center and never exists on this machine.
Source: Partner Center → EgyKode → Product management → Product Identity.
name: EgyKode

$calculated.$comment: Derived by the Store; not declared in the package manifest. Recorded for reference and for WNS if push is ever added.

$versionNote: Store packages must increase monotonically. 1.0.0.0 is reserved by Partner Center for the first submission, so the first uploaded package is 1.0.1.0 or later.
$icons: Generated by the site from the brand mark, not committed as binaries:
PWABuilder derives the full Windows tile set from these.
$checklistBeforePackaging: https://egykode.com/privacy/ returns 200 — Partner Center requires it
